cards.text: Moses, Israel's leader, broke the first stone tablets. Now the LORD tells him to chisel out two new stone tablets like the originals. Friend, I spent years in the back of a junk drawer before an angel called me out, so I LOVE a second chance.

cards.question: Moses is told to do the chiseling. The LORD says He will do the ___ on the new tablets Himself.

cards.text: Then the LORD sets the meeting: "Be ready in the morning, and come up on Mount Sinai to present yourself before Me on the mountaintop." A MORNING meeting on top of a MOUNTAIN, and I'd still be down at the bottom looking for my hat.

cards.question: Moses gets to bring a few helpers up the mountain with him.
Moses goes up by himself. What does the LORD say about the land in front of the mountain?

answers.text: No flocks or herds may graze there
A fence must go up there

cards.text: So Moses chisels out the tablets, gets up early, and carries two STONE tablets up Mount Sinai, just as the LORD commanded. I carry ONE cookie box up the bakery steps and have to sit down and rethink my whole life.

cards.question: Moses is up on Mount Sinai. How does the LORD come down to meet him?

cards.text: The LORD stands there with Moses and proclaims His name, the LORD. Then He passes in front of Moses and calls out who He is.

cards.question: The LORD calls Himself compassionate and gracious. How quickly does He get angry?

answers.text: He is never angry at all

cards.question: The LORD says He keeps up His loving devotion to a thousand generations.

cards.text: He forgives iniquity, transgression and sin. But He's not done describing Himself yet.

cards.question: The LORD says He will leave the guilty unpunished.

cards.text: Instead, the LORD says He "will visit the iniquity of the fathers on their children and grandchildren to the third and fourth generations."
Moses immediately bows down to the ground and worships. No warm-up, no "hold on one sec," just DOWN.

cards.question: Then Moses speaks up and asks the Lord for something. What does he ask?

answers.text: Go with us and forgive us
Send an angel ahead of us
Give us a king to lead us

cards.text: Moses is honest that this is a stiff-necked people. And he asks one more thing: "take us as Your inheritance."
The LORD answers Moses: "Behold, I am making a covenant." And He promises wonders that have never been done in any nation in all the world.

cards.question: The LORD tells Moses that the people around him will never notice what He is doing.

cards.text: Then the LORD says, "Observe what I command you this day." And He promises, "I will drive out before you the Amorites, Canaanites, Hittites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites."

cards.question: Once they enter the land, the LORD wants Israel to make treaties with the people living there.
Why does the LORD warn Israel against a treaty with the people of the land?
So what is Israel supposed to do with the altars, sacred stones and Asherah poles in the land?

answers.text: Use them all for the LORD

cards.question: Why tear it all down? Because Israel must not worship any other ___.

cards.text: And here's why: the LORD, "whose name is Jealous, is a jealous God."

cards.question: The LORD warns that if Israel makes a covenant with the people of the land, those people will invite Israel to eat their sacrifices.

cards.text: It goes further. If Israel's sons take brides from the people of the land, the LORD says, "their daughters will prostitute themselves to their gods and cause your sons to do the same."

cards.question: Next comes a short command about molten gods. What does the LORD say about them?

cards.text: Then come rules for Israel's year: the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the Feast of Weeks, the Feast of Ingathering, the firstborn that belong to the LORD, and all the males appearing before Him three times a year. There's even a seventh day of rest during plowing and harvest season, which is like me still taking my day off in the busiest week of the year.
Then the LORD tells Moses, "Write down these words, for in accordance with these words I have made a covenant with you and with Israel."

cards.question: How long is Moses up on the mountain with the LORD?
During that time up on the mountain, Moses eats bread and drinks water.

cards.text: Forty days with no bread and no water, and I get cranky when the oven runs five minutes late. And now the tablets hold the words of the covenant, the Ten Commandments.
Moses comes down from Mount Sinai with the two tablets of the Testimony in his hands. But something about him has changed from speaking with the LORD.

cards.question: Something about Moses has become radiant from speaking with the LORD. What is it?
Moses knows his face is radiant as he comes down the mountain.

cards.text: Aaron, Moses' brother, and all the Israelites look at Moses, and behold, his face is radiant. Meanwhile Moses is strolling in like it's a regular Tuesday, glowing like my oven light with NO idea.

cards.question: When Aaron and the Israelites see Moses' radiant face, they rush right up to him.
The people are keeping their distance from Moses. What does Moses do?

answers.text: He hides in the Tent of Meeting
He goes back up the mountain

cards.text: Aaron and all the leaders of the congregation come back to him, and Moses talks with them.

cards.question: After the leaders, all the Israelites come near to Moses too.
With all the Israelites gathered around, what does Moses do?

answers.text: He passes on the LORD's commands
He sends them back to their tents
He tells them to wait for Aaron

cards.text: When Moses finishes speaking with them, he puts a veil over his face.

cards.question: Whenever Moses goes in before the LORD to speak with Him, he ___ the veil until he comes out.

cards.text: When he comes out, Moses tells the Israelites what he was commanded, and they see that his face is radiant. Every single time, and when I come out of MY bakery, all my face shows is flour.
So Moses puts the veil back over his face until he goes in to speak with the LORD again.
